label_method: Manual case-by-case review of each exact proposal business-case question against the current public corpus inventory and checked source text. Availability describes this demo corpus, not product capability; partial/unsupported cases should abstain when no cited evidence answers the question.

cases.rationale: The corpus has public governance documents but no explicit document or records retention standard answering this request.

The Code of Conduct (January 2010) contains a Network and access section with task-based access, manager and IT approval for exceptions, and a prohibition on unauthorized access. It points to a separate Information System Policy, which is not in the corpus; the answer must identify its source and not imply the full policy is present. The public Code of Conduct applies to employees, so the synthetic demo ACL allows employee retrieval.
The 2025 sustainability report mentions annual-leave increments by seniority, but the corpus has no full leave policy or entitlement schedule.
No executed commercial or employment contracts are in the public corpus.
The official 2024 annual report contains consolidated revenue and profit after tax with source pages.
The 2020 annual report states that trade-related amounts due to related parties were payable within 60 days from invoice date, but no invoice or general invoice policy is in the corpus.
Annual reports discuss operations but no production or equipment-maintenance manual is included.

The official Vinamilk Shop policy updated 2026-01-08 states store return/refund eligibility, conditions, same-day timing and customer-service contact. It does not establish a general policy for other sales channels or every support issue.
No server, software-installation or infrastructure setup guide is in the public corpus.
The corpus contains corporate-governance regulations and a code of conduct, but no general compliance-policy document.

The 2024 and 2025 reports provide documented strategy, initiatives, and some risk context, but do not establish a decision brief with alternatives. Cite these reports, distinguish reported initiatives from leadership alternatives, and disclose when the cited passages do not state a requested risk.
The authenticated analytics query can aggregate the available document metadata by domain; this does not imply source coverage in unsupported domains.
